_comment: judge_fix2 W2 (NOT APPLIED). New HTTP node, placed between Write Judgment 3 and Derive Outcome (the row and the judgments exist by then). It posts the run's enforcer log that Alternate Merge builds (enforcer_log_body) to record_enforcer_log, as Write Judgment 1-3 post to record_debate_judgment, with the same credential, retry and error output. Connections: Write Judgment 3 (main 0) -> Write Enforcer Log; Write Enforcer Log (main 0) -> Derive Outcome; Write Enforcer Log (error output) -> Derive Outcome, so a failed log write never stops the grading. Requires sql/w2_debate_enforcer_log.sql applied first.
